verify_notes: Species and location corroborated by two independent sources: the Metropole de Lyon's own PLU-H remarkable-tree register (tree-level coordinates, 45.772238/4.875398) and a 2025-08-26 Mediacites investigative piece mapping the same database, which independently names this exact tree at this exact street corner ('a l'angle des rues Viret et de Pressense, a Villeurbanne'). Flagged only because no age or girth is documented by either source; do not invent one, leave age_estimate as 'not documented' and let the page ask readers with a tape measure. Register calls the species genuinely rare for Villeurbanne's street planting and notes good health and large size ('Bonne sante. Grande dimension.') as of its last survey (2017); the 2025 Mediacites piece is good evidence it was still standing and still considered remarkable eight years later. Sits on a public street corner in the Gratte-Ciel/Les Poulettes area of Villeurbanne, about 1.4 km east of the existing lyo_001/002/003/010 cluster around Parc de la Tete d'Or's arboretum, so it extends the existing walk rather than adding a distant outlier (well within the city's existing 5.5 km span, and inside the 30-minute transit boundary CLAUDE.md allows for day-trip-adjacent trees). Reverse-geocoded via Nominatim to confirm the coordinate genuinely sits on Rue Viret in Villeurbanne's Gratte-Ciel/Les Poulettes district (69100), consistent with the register's own street name.
